$ go test  # probe
    script/marked: The probe says no to a cell a gaps line marks.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        gaps, line 1, marks the cell, and echo's probe says the case isn't for it: no formulas
        Remove the line, or fix the probe.
    script/no: echo's probe says the case isn't for it: already serves 4
    script/noreason: The probe says no, and gives no reason.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        echo's probe said the case isn't for it, and gave no reason.
        Fix the probe: when it says no, it says why.
    script/panics: The probe panics.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        echo's probe panicked: probe overflow
        Fix the probe. A panic is never an expected error.
        out/echo/error.txt has no golden.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it, and read it before committing.
        out/echo/inputs has no golden.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it, and read it before committing.
        out/echo/outcome has no golden.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it, and read it before committing.
    stack of the panic: [stack]
    script/stale: The probe now says no, and the cell has files from when it said yes.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        out/echo/values.txt is recorded, and echo's probe says the case isn't for it: no formulas
        If the suite should run on the case, fix the probe. If not, delete the section by hand; FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... leaves it in place.
